newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes down against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes down against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down at 8.2970 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai on Thursday from Wednesday's 8.2965 on spectulative selling late in the session, traders said.
The weighted average price on Wednesday was 8.2965.
The yuan opened higher at an intraday high of 8.2961 but fell slightly soon after to move around 8.2965 for most of the session, hitting a low of 8.2972.
Trading was less active than Wednesday with most done at about 8.2965, traders said.
Dealers said speculative selling by some designated banks, on a belief that the yuan would trend down in the short term, emerged in late trading, causing the currency to close lower.
One dealer said technical charts had indicated the yuan had the potential to fall, with its movements over the past week largely confined to a narrow range of 8.2960 and 8.2970.

"The yuan has met strong resistance during its attempts to regain the 8.2950 level over the past week," he said. "Most people think the yuan now has more potential to fall than rise in the short term."
Dealers said they expected the yuan to move around the 8.2970 level on Friday.
The yuan closed up at 6.5206 from 6.5700 against 100 Japanese yen and up at 1.0690 from 1.0700 against the Hong Kong dollar.
